items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't work with him. ... He had his own band up there. Good band, too. Yeah, very good. He was a pretty big name, drawing, you know.

ctx.x: No. Dan played in B-natural and F-sharp. That would keep me from working with him. And he didn't have any music to read. And if it was in B-natural and F-sharp I still wouldn't work with him! No, but he could play, though. I didn't work with him. Yeah, he was another one of them Fats Waller types. He could play.
Well, now, Wendell Culley was up there, too, wasn't he?
